Fixed normal deployment UTC microseconds and selected a public detail from a public-list link after reproducing the hidden-item false alarm.

After durable legacy trigger receipt was added, the existing 3-artifact expectation failed; the corrected test verifies exact filenames and the two trigger namespaces. The other 4 scenarios had already passed.

planDecisions.next: Require merged source, passing required Actions checks, and authenticated exhaustive old-version in-flight/side-effect evidence before fencing.

limitations: No public authenticated exhaustive HTTP/R2 evidence source was identified for the uninstrumented legacy Worker.
